verdict.rationale: GrowthBook lists "Safe rollouts" as a paid-tier feature, and experiments can be configured with guardrail metrics. Both point toward metric-guarded releases, but the evidence never describes how Safe rollouts behave. The community question in growthbook-comm-7 about metric-monitored rollouts is not a hands-on counter-example, so it does not create a dispute. missing for 10: documentation of Safe rollouts monitoring guardrail metrics on a feature rollout, automatic regression detection, automatic rollback when a regression is found, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
